cad_001: You can recognise it by its aerial roots thickening into extra trunks over the marble terrace, larger than its twin fig nearby. It stands on the Alameda Apodaca seafront.
cad_002: You can recognise it by its squat grey trunk branching into an umbrella-shaped crown. It stands near the north entrance of Parque Genoves.
cad_003: You can recognise it by its multiple trunks rising from the base, more shrub than tree until you see the size of the limbs, with a support structure fitted after storm damage. It stands in Parque Genoves.
cad_005: You can recognise it by its swollen, bottle-shaped trunk studded with conical thorns. It stands behind the cafe in Parque Genoves, near the fountain statue.
